fields.name: resolution
fields.title: Resolution
fields.description: Video resolution - 480p for faster generation, 720p for balance, 1080p for high quality.

fields.name: draft
fields.title: Draft
fields.description: Generate a draft preview at 480p, overriding resolution. Returns a draft_id for completing the draft at 1080p within 14 days.

fields.name: duration
fields.title: Duration
fields.description: Duration of the video in seconds. Supports 4 to 30 seconds, or auto to let the model decide based on the prompt.

fields.name: aspect_ratio
fields.title: Aspect Ratio
fields.description: The aspect ratio of the generated video. Always "auto" for image-to-video

fields.name: generate_audio
fields.title: Generate Audio
fields.description: Whether to generate synchronized audio for the video, including sound effects, ambient sounds, and lip-synced speech. The cost of video generation is the same regardless of whether audio is generated or not.

fields.name: bitrate_mode
fields.title: Bitrate Mode
fields.description: Output bitrate mode. 'high' requests a higher-quality, larger-file encode from the model; 'standard' uses the default bitrate.

fields.name: codec
fields.title: Codec
fields.description: 'auto' retains default video codec behaviour; 'H264' uses H.264; 'H265' uses H.265.

fields.name: end_user_id
fields.title: End User Id
fields.description: The unique user ID of the end user.
